title: test(plugin-grid,console): pin the member shapes object-grid reads for its four per-row keys (objectui#8071 slice 12)
body:
Refs #8071 — objectui#8071 slice 12. This PR addresses one slice only; the card stays open, and eleven exemptions remain after it.

Clause-②: no

## What this slice takes

Four `object-grid` keys leave `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTIONS` and enter `MEMBER_PINS`, with `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTION_CEILING` moving **24 -> 20 in the same commit** — the new count, not the new count plus room:

| key | pin file | new / grown |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `object-grid.rowColor` | `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridRowDecorationMembers-8071.test.tsx` | new |
| `object-grid.conditionalFormatting` | same file | new |
| `object-grid.operations` | `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridOperationsMembers-8071.test.tsx` | new |
| `object-grid.rowActions` | `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/legacyRowActionDispatch.test.tsx` | grown, then registered |

This is the **first bite out of `object-grid`**, which held 15 — the largest remaining block and the first that cannot fit one slice.

### Set identity, computed rather than asserted

Read off `HEAD~1` vs the working tree with a script that parses both constants:

```
exemptions base/cur: 24 20
pins       base/cur: 67 71
LEFT exemptions : object-grid.conditionalFormatting, object-grid.operations, object-grid.rowActions, object-grid.rowColor
ENTERED pins    : object-grid.conditionalFormatting, object-grid.operations, object-grid.rowActions, object-grid.rowColor
ENTERED exemptions: []   LEFT pins: []   SET IDENTITY: true
```

## The batch is not the one that was suggested, and why

The dispatch suggested the grid's query-and-display core (`columns`, `sort`, `filter`, `grouping`) and said plainly it had not read the sites. I re-took the constant myself before the first edit — instrument `grep -n` over `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTIONS` in `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` at `origin/main` `0ee6e316e` — and confirmed 24 exemptions, ceiling 24, with `object-grid` holding the 15 keys the dispatch listed. None of the four I took was already pinned.

Read, the suggested four are four separate slices: `columns` pulls in the whole column fold and the `$select` projection, `grouping` pulls in `useGroupedData`, and `filter` / `sort` each already carry dedicated files (`gridFilterInputSpelling`, `gridArrayArmOrderby-8973`, `gridRetiredStringSort-8767`, `serverSorting`) that need reading end to end before they can be promoted or grown.

What **is** one read is the per-ROW layer:

- `rowColor` and `conditionalFormatting` are consumed on **adjacent lines** of the `DataTable` props construction (`rowClassName` / `rowStyle`) and land on the **same row element** — one through `cn(...)`, one through the inline `style` attribute.
- `operations` and `rowActions` are read inside the **same row-affordance fold** and meet at the **same gate** in `resolveRowCrudAffordances`, where — the finding this slice pins — they are a **UNION** rather than an intersection.

Two files, four keys, two reads.

## Each pin shown failing, and each restore proven

Every leg mutated the read site toward a **plausible improvement**, ran the pinned suite, restored with `git checkout HEAD --` plus the file's ABSOLUTE path under an `EXIT INT TERM` trap, and proved the restore by blob hash equality against `git rev-parse HEAD:` plus that same path plus an empty `git diff HEAD`. Each mutation was proven to have reached disk first: the anchor's occurrence count in the file goes 1 -> 0 and the replacement's 0 -> 1, and the mutated blob hash differs from HEAD's.

| leg | mutation (toward the plausible improvement) | consequence if taken | measured |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rowColor` | `useRowColor.ts`: `String(row[config.field] ?? '')` -> `String(row[config.field])` ("String() already handles null") | a record whose colour field is empty stops matching the author's `''` entry — the only way to colour "not set yet" — and silently loses its row colour | **1 failed / 14 passed** |
| `conditionalFormatting` | `listConditional.ts`: `style.color = String(rule.textColor)` -> `style.textColor = ...` ("keep the authored name") | React drops an unknown style key in silence: same rules, same background, the text colour gone with nothing thrown | **3 failed / 56 passed** across the pin file and core's own suite |
| `operations` | `ObjectGrid.tsx`: `explicitOperations ?? { update, delete }` -> `{ update, delete, ...explicitOperations }` ("merge the defaults instead of replacing them") | an author who wrote `operations: { export: false }` to close one door silently gets row Edit/Delete back; the authored block stops being able to close anything | **3 failed / 7 passed** |
| `rowActions` | `ObjectGrid.tsx`: `rowActionsList.filter(a => a !== 'edit' && a !== 'delete')` -> `rowActionsList` ("the fold already drops a name it has no def for") | each canonical name renders a SECOND Edit/Delete beside the built-in one, dispatching a type the runner has no handler for — the working/dead pair objectui#2960 removed, back for the canonical two | **2 failed / 5 passed** |

The `conditionalFormatting` leg is the one that reaches outside `plugin-grid`: `listConditional.ts` is shared, so two pre-existing core cases (`native operators: ...`, `color props override the base style map`) go red alongside my row. Reported rather than hidden — it is the same read site, and the shared sink is exactly why the member fact is worth pinning.

Blob hashes for the record: `useRowColor.ts` HEAD `5c0cfcf` / mutated `99cab39`; `listConditional.ts` HEAD `1d494e6` / mutated `cdcc5d8`; `ObjectGrid.tsx` HEAD `552dc5a` / mutated `a7de214` (operations) and `9263ad6` (rowActions). All four restored to their HEAD hash with `git diff HEAD` empty.

One instrument correction worth recording: the harness's first `operations` leg was **voided by its own counter**, not by the mutation. It counted occurrences with `grep -cF`, which for a multi-line needle matches any single line of it and answered 53 / 52 instead of 1 / 0. The mutation had in fact landed — the re-run under a whole-file `str.count` produced the identical mutated blob `a7de214`. The first reading was discarded rather than reinterpreted.

## Typecheck coverage, proven rather than assumed

This repo carves tests out of the package build config, so "it typechecks" has to be shown per program.

- `packages/plugin-grid`: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles --noEmit` exits **0** over **1728** program inputs, and all three touched test files appear exactly once. Non-vacuity in the same listing: `packages/plugin-grid/src/**/*.test.tsx` reads **103**, while `plugin-kanban`'s test files read **0** and `apps/console`'s read **0** — the project is reading this package's tests and only this package's tests. `tsc --noEmit` (the source program) also exits 0.
- `apps/console`: `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` exits **0** over **3764** inputs with `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` present once, and `plugin-grid`'s test files absent.

## Changeset grade: MEASURED from a build, with a lit and an absent control on the same corpus

Graded **empty frontmatter — declares no release** — after building `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/console` (dependency closures first) and probing each package's published corpus, i.e. exactly the paths its `package.json` `files[]` ships.

```
corpus: @object-ui/plugin-grid files[]  (dist README.md CHANGELOG.md LICENSE)
  LIT    useRowColor                 10
  LIT    resolveLegacyRowActions      8
  ABSENT rowColourClasses             0
  ABSENT gridOperationsMembers        0
  ABSENT gridRowDecorationMembers     0
  ABSENT legacyRowActionDispatch      0
  ABSENT "CANONICAL members"          0

corpus: @object-ui/console files[]  (dist plugin.ts plugin.js plugin.d.ts README.md)
  LIT    ConsolePlugin               12
  LIT    data-boot-theme              6      (this one proves apps/console/src content DOES reach dist)
  LIT    accept-invitation-page       1
  ABSENT MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTION_CEILING 0
  ABSENT MEMBER_PINS                  0
  ABSENT AWAITING_A_PIN               0
  ABSENT memberPinProblem             0
```

One hit needs stating rather than rounding away: the string `registry-inputs-spec-parity` reads **2** in the console corpus. Both are inside `dist/assets/vendor-objectstack-*.js` — a docstring in the vendored `@objectstack/spec` package that names the file. That is a mention of the file NAME, not these bytes; it is there identically without this commit, and every probe over the file's own CONTENT reads 0. My first console probe used `consolePlugin` as the lit control, which reads 0 — an unlit control makes the whole reading worthless, so it was replaced with the three above before any conclusion was drawn.

`node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exits 0 ("Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter"), `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` exits 0.

## Serial constraint, re-taken over the open-PR set immediately before the first write

All **15** open PRs enumerated through the REST proxy and each one's file list read: **zero** touch `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, and no objectui#8071 slice PR is in flight. Taken before the first edit and before the branch carried any commit.

## Tests and gates

| run | result |
| --- | --- |
| `vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` | **139 files / 1486 tests passed** |
| `vitest run --project @object-ui/console` | **101 files / 1158 tests passed** |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid lint` | exit 0 (0 errors, 846 pre-existing warnings) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console lint` | exit 0 (0 errors, 212 pre-existing warnings) |
| repo-wide `eslint . --no-inline-config --format json` | 5074 files; my four files contribute **0 errors** (7 `no-explicit-any` warnings, the spelling every sibling grid harness already uses). The 95 errors it reports are pre-existing and are an artifact of `--no-inline-config`, which CI's `turbo run lint` does not pass |
| `check:control-bytes` `check:new-line-citations` `check:test-path-roots` `check:vi-mock-specifiers` `check:vi-mock-inherit` `check:vi-mock-override-shape` `check:changeset-claims` `check:pending-changeset-literals` `check:shell-escape-residue` `check:comment-mask-corpus` `check:unreferenced-sources` | all exit 0 |
| `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the five changed paths | NOT GOVERNED |

Heavy runs went through `../objectstack/scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; every verdict line above is the wrapper's own `VERDICT command-exit`, and exit codes were captured to disk before any pipe.

## Acceptance notes

Out-of-scope observations, none filed (the seat files):

- `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` carries a prose comment reading "`MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTIONS` below lists all 50 remaining keys BY NAME" and "a 51st entry". That count has been stale since the ceiling passed 50 several slices ago; nothing asserts it and it is prose, not a mechanism. Noted, not filed — the next slice to touch that docblock is the natural carrier.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx` computes the display `pageSize` as `schema.pagination?.pageSize || schema.pageSize || 10` while the two state seeds beside it use the same `||` chain with different floors (10 and 50). A falsy authored `pageSize: 0` therefore falls through all three. Not reproduced against a real author path and not one of this slice's keys — noted for whoever takes `object-grid.pagination`, which is still exempt.
- The generic row-action entry for an unresolvable name and the built-in entry for a canonical name render under different testid prefixes (`row-action-` plus the NAME, versus `row-action-builtin-` plus the NAME). That asymmetry is what makes the `rowActions` pin checkable and is recorded here only so the next reader does not treat the two prefixes as interchangeable. Noted, not filed.

The `conditionalFormatting` ablation's collateral (two core cases red under a shared-sink mutation) is behaviour of the mutation, not a finding about `main`.
